purpose: Selected-vehicle remote command center with fleet context, vehicle evidence, readiness, searchable categorized actions, favorites, guarded input/confirmation dialogs and latest per-command outcomes.
primaryGoal: Select the workspace vehicle, review trustworthy readiness, send an authorized live remote action and inspect its reported outcome.

dataSources.behavior: Shared roster query and safeArray selection; cancellation signal forwarded. Roster state is explicitly historical, not proof of reachability.
Selected vehicle query forwards cancellation, maps nullable state and trust metadata, respects as_of cache identity and disables historical polling. Live center requests 15000ms polling.
Latest outcome per command, normalized vehicle key, cancellation and null-array normalization, periodic refresh. Container consumes payload but discards loading/error/freshness/retry state.
Source inspection only; never invoked. requiresLiveMode, success discriminator, toast, vehicle/latest/history/roster invalidation and expired-Tesla-auth recovery queue must survive.
dataSources.backendLimits: Router proves route registration only. Authorization internals, command support, vendor units, execution outcome and recovery replay were not exercised.

dataSources.behavior: URL > persisted store > first valid fleet vehicle; reconciles unknown IDs, retains unrelated URL parameters and shares roster query. No page-local picker.
Per-vehicle localStorage favorite IDs with defaults and malformed/storage-failure fallback; group expansion uses per-vehicle sessionStorage.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: CommandTile, ToggleCommandTile and InputCommandTile repeat clickable GlassPanel geometry, nested favorite control, icon, pending, disabled and result presentation; their keyboard handlers have already diverged.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Consolidate the feature-local tile presentation into one accessible command tile frame with sibling action and favorite buttons, leaving dispatch/toggle/input business logic in existing owners.

sourceEvidence: CommandsPage.tsx:100 uses full-width wrapping history actions, sm auto width and min-h-11.
CommandCenterHero.tsx:76 stacks identity/status before lg; VIN uses break-all.
CommandWorkspace.tsx:147 stacks heading/search before lg; search results use two/three/four columns.
CommandDomainBrowser.tsx:50 uses two-column domains before xl.

issues.detail: Selected vehicle name is truncated without an explicit full-name affordance; two-column tiles also need narrow-container and long-translation checks, not presumed acceptance.
issues.fix: Prefer wrapping the vehicle heading or provide an accessible full-name expansion; exercise long labels and tile/favorite target separation at 320-430px.

responsive.viewportAcceptance: unverified at all specified widths; no browser was launched

sourceEvidence: CommandReadinessStrip.tsx:130 uses polite atomic feedback announcements.
CommandTile.tsx:49 and ToggleCommandTile.tsx:66 ignore descendant key events; InputCommandTile does not.
CommandConfirmDialog uses Modal, countdown and typed confirmation; dialog focus trapping/restoration is delegated to shared Modal and unexercised.

issues.detail: Enter/Space on the nested favorite button bubbles into the tile handler, which prevents default and opens the command input dialog. Sibling command/toggle handlers explicitly guard target !== currentTarget.
issues.fix: Immediately match the descendant-event guard; preferably render separate sibling native Button targets in the feature-local frame so favorite never activates the command.

issues.detail: Custom tablist has tab roles and aria-selected/controls but no tab IDs, panel aria-labelledby, roving tabIndex or arrow/Home/End keyboard implementation.
issues.fix: Use the canonical shared Tabs contract after verifying it supports this domain layout, or retain ordinary buttons/group semantics; preserve every domain/category and selection behavior.

issues.detail: Typed-confirmation Input has placeholder and preceding HelperText but no label, aria-label or aria-labelledby connecting its instruction to the field.
issues.fix: Supply a localized Input label and linked instruction while preserving exact confirmation word, case-insensitive matching, countdown and modal behavior.

issues.detail: All three tile variants contain a native favorite button inside a role=button container. This combines interactive semantics and risks descendant accessibility representation despite pointer propagation guards.
issues.fix: Use a non-interactive card with independently named command and favorite Button targets; preserve 44px favorites, pressed state, read-only reason and loading.

accessibility.keyboardScreenReaderContrastForcedColors: unverified; findings above are source defects/risks, not executed interaction results

states.initialLoading: Fleet fallback retains three sections with skeleton geometry; hero/brief independently supports state loading.
states.empty: Fleet connect-account recovery, live-state-unavailable guidance and clear-search no-results recovery exist.
states.error: Fleet QueryError retry and vehicle-state QueryError retry exist; roster retained refresh warning exists.
states.offlineHistorical: useOperationalMode disables workspace and closes active dialog; executeCommand rechecks canWrite; mutation client requiresLiveMode. Controls remain selectable for uncertain/asleep/offline vehicle state in live mode, with explanatory warnings.
states.retained: Hero/readiness pass retained state to SystemSummaryBrief; fleet content retained through shared DataState.

issues.detail: latestQuery.data ?? [] hides initial loading, fatal failure and background refresh failure. Workspace sees neither latestQuery error nor dataUpdatedAt/refetch and cannot distinguish no attempts from unavailable/stale outcomes.
issues.fix: Adapt latest query with useDataState, pass trust/retry into workspace and retain existing badges on refresh failure. Render independent status/recovery without disabling unrelated command availability.

issues.detail: A present state object with an absent/null stateField becomes false; absent state uses false localToggle. Workspace supplies no field-trust metadata, so an unverified reading can appear as an authoritative ON/OFF control.
issues.fix: Carry existing verifiedFields/freshness through workspace, show unknown/last-known explicitly, and preserve command availability and on/off command semantics rather than inventing a state or disabling everything.

issues.detail: Every latest status other than literal success receives a failure cross; unknown/pending backend statuses cannot be inferred as failures. Actual backend status vocabulary was not inspected.
issues.fix: Confirm the existing backend vocabulary before mapping; preserve explicit success/failure and render unsupported statuses neutrally with source text.

visualIssues.detail: Decorative cyan-to-purple hero wash adds unrelated hue; verified online also requests an ongoing pulse at line 94.
visualIssues.fix: Remove the decorative wash, retain neutral panel tokens and semantic status text/dot; remove decorative continuous pulse without changing status trust.

visualIssues.detail: ON state uses neon panel/icon/dot palettes; ordinary tiles repeat neon hover borders, favorites use neon amber, input submit overrides shared primary with neon cyan and select options override focus with neon cyan.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing surface/border/focus tokens and subdued semantic success/danger accents only where meaningful; remove arbitrary page palette overrides. Keep ON/OFF text, favorite stars and destructive warning cues.

visualIssues.detail: Selected domain adds hardcoded cyan, panel uses fixed white transparency at line 82 and CommandSearch overrides Input with white surface/border at line 21.
visualIssues.fix: Let Button/Input canonical variants own selected, field and focus styling; use existing surface and border variables rather than fixed-white overlays.

visualIssues.detail: All three command dialogs explicitly apply backdrop-blur-xl; confirmation also establishes a red modal border, bypassing canonical flat surface defaults.
visualIssues.fix: Remove unnecessary blur/surface overrides; communicate destructive meaning through existing danger Button and a restrained localized warning rather than the entire modal.

architectureIssues.detail: Local Vehicle, VehicleState and CommandLogEntry interfaces compete with shared vehicle/API/hook types; local state omits freshness/verified-field metadata needed by command toggles.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing authoritative API/domain types and trust helpers when compatible; keep CommandDef as feature configuration. Do not rewrite unit contracts as a cosmetic change.

architectureIssues.detail: Speed-limit form explicitly uses MPH and limit_mph. Only this definition and router registration were inspected; vendor/backend conversion semantics are unknown.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve vendor command name/parameter/validation until backend boundary is verified. Do not blindly rename to SI or introduce conversion during visual modernization; retained SI display metrics stay unchanged.

dataBehavior: Preserve query keys, cancellation, polling, retry policy and invalidations.
Keep numeric battery percent, distance SI and temperature readings in OperationalBrief's existing formatting pipeline.
Preserve nullable readings and explicit observedAt/freshness/verifiedFields; do not replace unknown with zero/OFF.
Use workspace selection and keyed vehicle center to isolate favorites/search/dialog state across vehicle changes.
/commands range=false, vehicle=true from workspaceScope; no new date picker needed for live actions.
Treat request acceptance separately from physical execution; do not invent command capabilities.
Preserve localStorage/sessionStorage key names, theme/unit preferences, route aliases and wire params.
